others.route: Permit to enter and reside (Principal Immigration Officer)

note: Tuvalu: no one may enter without a permit or an exemption (Immigration Act, Cap. 24.15, 2008 Revised Edition, s. 6); the permit to enter and reside is issued on conditions as to the profession or occupation its holder may engage in and the employer who may employ him (s. 8), and a visitor's permit is for up to a month (s. 9). The Immigration (Amendment) Act 2019 only adds a waiver of the entry permit with a visitor's permit under agreements; persons with a genuine link to Tuvalu may enter and reside without a permit but not take paid employment (LN 2/2006). Reading: the Act doesn't say in so many words that a visitor may not work; the route is the permit that sets the holder's occupation and employer. Read in PacLII's copies through archive.org (snapshots of 30 October 2013 and 15 December 2024), since PacLII and Tuvalu's own legislation site refuse this client. No days are modelled.

sources.title: Immigration Act (Tuvalu, Cap. 24.15, 2008 Revised Edition), ss. 6, 8 (PacLII's copy, archive.org snapshot of 30 October 2013)
sources.said: No person shall enter Tuvalu from any place outside Tuvalu unless — (a) he is in possession of a valid permit lawfully issued to him under this Act ... The Principal Immigration Officer may issue a permit in the prescribed form authorising any person to enter and reside in Tuvalu, upon such conditions as to the security to be furnished, the profession or occupation which such person may exercise or engage in and the employer or employers by whom he may be employed within Tuvalu

sources.title: Immigration (Amendment) Act 2019 (Tuvalu, Act No. 2 of 2019) (PacLII's copy, archive.org snapshot of 15 December 2024)
sources.said: The Principal Immigration Officer shall waive the entry permit requirement and issue a visitor’s permit for such period as prescribed under the agreement and Regulations.

sources.title: Persons Entitled to Enter Tuvalu without Permit Order (Cap. 24.15.2, LN 2/2006) (PacLII's copy, archive.org snapshot of 15 December 2024)
sources.said: Persons under this category shall not be engaged in paid employment.
